source: synthetic. Qoder CLI is not a Sidecar provider and no capture of one
        exists here. This screen is built to the shape upstream's
        `spinner_working` rule describes — a single braille frame, a space, and
        a line carrying at least one letter — and deliberately omits the
        "(esc to cancel," hint, because `cancel_hint_working` at priority 100
        would otherwise carry the verdict and the spinner rule would never be
        the one that reports.
why: manifests/sidecar/qodercli.toml rewrites that rule's `\p{Alphabetic}` as
     `[\p{L}\p{Nl}]` because RE2 cannot compile the property, and until this
     fixture the rewrite had no coverage of any kind. See the same note in
     ../kiro/tool_spinner_working.txt.
